title: Capabilities result
description: The capabilities object returned by the capabilities command. Engine-wide sections are always present; document and allowedCommands appear only when the request carried a sessionId.

preview.description: Whether pages can be rasterized right now.

ocr.description: Whether text can be recognized right now, and with what.

engine.description: Name and version of the installed recognizer, empty when there is none.

languages.description: Installed language codes. Empty when OCR is not ready.

operations.description: Every operation kind this version accepts, each with its own readiness so a caller never learns a limit by catching an error mid-batch.

detail.description: Human-readable reason when not ready, empty when ready.

requires.description: Engine-wide capabilities this operation depends on.

filters.description: Stream filters this version can decode, named without their leading slash.

read.description: Deprecated alias of document, retained because removing a field is forbidden. Identical content.

allowedCommands.description: Commands that may be issued with this open session. Present only alongside document.

detail.description: Human-readable reason when not ready, empty when ready.

document.description: What this specific document can be read for, as opposed to edited into. Present only when a sessionId was supplied.

structuralEdit.description: Reordering, deleting, rotating, cropping, importing and saving. Always ready: these copy stream bytes through without decoding them.

textContent.description: Anything that must look inside stream bytes. Blocked when the pages reach a stream whose filters this version cannot decode.

detail.description: Human-readable reason when blocked, empty when ready.

filters.description: Sorted distinct names of the filters that could not be decoded. Empty when ready.

objectCount.description: Distinct stream objects carrying those filters. Zero when ready.
